BiblicalUsage: Pente means five. Paul would rather speak five words with understanding in the church than ten thousand in an unknown tongue, and the number of the men who believed was about five thousand.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe five clear words beat ten thousand clouded ones: God counts understanding, not volume.
